pages.text: Clear a three-by-three area for the basin. Use the empty hand on the center or a wall to open the tank menu.
Use a water bucket on the tub. Hold each ingredient and use it on the tub once per item. A matching set starts a short stew that converts the whole volume. Use an empty vessel to draw out the result.

pages.title: After the Bubbles
pages.text: The tank locks transfers while it stews. A mix of accepted items that matches no recipe turns the whole tank to slurry. Use exact quantities from the $(l:psychedelicraft:preparations/mash_catalog)mash catalogue$(/l).
